title: Chapter 420
paragraphs: Chapter 420
121. Betrayal (3)
"Reward?"
"A reward?"
Dante and Beradin asked simultaneously.
"Yes, Vice-head."
"Perhaps His Majesty wants to bestow a reward for protecting Hailan, which is also his territory."
"It seems so."
Dante's expression darkened. It was due to the Emperor's detestable behavior of praising Jin on the surface while pressuring Hailan from behind.
Dante, by nature, was well-mannered and a servant, so he couldn't express any more displeasure, but he couldn't help but feel upset.
The knight who delivered the news also seemed to suppress his gloomy feelings.
"That's a bad guy, really. Dante is so kind, and he doesn't even know that. Childish."
When Beradin suddenly said that, Dante and the knight's eyes widened.
They had never heard anyone speak ill of the Emperor before. Even Ron, who was famous for not using honorifics to the Emperor, had never uttered such words.
"I thought it was time to see the face that the palace people dared to call 'heavenly' in person. It's a good thing."
When Jin added another comment, Dante and the knight unknowingly looked around. It was a reflexive action, though it was clear that there were no ears to hear.

Even without this incident, Jin didn't have good feelings toward the Emperor. He had been involved with the Special Forces several times, and even fought against the Royal Guards in the Wantaralamo Forest not long ago.
Moreover, he looked down on Tichan Free City and secretly produced 'Mine'; there was no room for a good view.
"Hmm, hmm. Friends. But still, he is the supreme ruler of the Empire…"
"I'm not a Bement person either, so it's fine. It's fine."
In the end, Dante awkwardly smiled. Inwardly, he felt relieved by the two's words.
"I'm glad to have you guys."
"Heh, me too. Dante!"
Dante and Beradin looked at Jin at the same time, with expressions that said, "You too."
Jin ignored their small desire, though.
"I'm curious about what kind of gift he'll give. Can I go right away?"
"Yes, Sir Jin."
Jin got up from his seat, stretching.
"I heard other forces are leaving the Imperial City today, so I should stop by the palace and return to the main house."
"Is it so sudden?"
Beradin asked, widening his eyes.

"It's not sudden. You just got here, but I've been here for about two weeks. We've more or less finished our discussion, so it's only right for me to return to my place. Rune Candle Knights are quite busy, you know."
Dante was also reluctant to let Jin go, but he couldn't hold him back.
In the first place, Jin could return whenever he wanted.
If it wasn't Jin but another knight at the scene of the terror, Hailan wouldn't have asked Rune Candle to stay until the investigation was over.
Jin had purely devoted his time to helping Dante as a friend. Now it was time for him to return and do his own work.
"But I just got here."
"Well, now go back and do your best to put pressure on Jiplei in Hailan. You're busy too."
"I'm disappointed…"
Just before leaving the basement with the knight, Jin looked back at his friends.
Beradin's spirits were suddenly deflated due to his resentment, and Dante was patting Beradin's back.
"In any situation, we just have to make sure the three of us don't betray each other."
Seeing his friends nodding their heads, a grin appeared on Jin's face.
If he had been born as the eldest instead of the youngest in an ordinary family, not Rune Candle, he might have had siblings like them. The thought suddenly crossed his mind.
"Take care, Jin. Let's meet again soon. Let's have a drink then!"
"Good luck, my friend."
As he followed the knight out of the basement, the bright sunlight stung his eyes.
Under the cloudless sky, the half-destroyed and blackened Imperial City seemed out of place.
"I need to pay my respects to Sir Ron. Where is he?"
"I'll take you to him."
Ron was sitting alone in the nearly collapsed main hall.
Although it was completely destroyed, the throne of the Imperial City that was in the main hall remained intact.
To Jin, it seemed to symbolize the situation of Hailan. Despite being attacked inside and out, the great warrior Ron Hailan seemed to be able to protect that throne in the end.
Perhaps, he wanted to think that way because he knew Ron's condition was not good.
"The Emperor has summoned you?"
When Ron sensed Jin's presence, he opened his mouth, and the knight stepped aside.
"Yes."
"Those royal characters are good at summoning busy people. You'll have to listen to their nonsense and be insulted."
Ron's attitude towards Jin had changed. Ron no longer saw Jin as just a 'devilish guy who bewitched his grandson'.
It was because, since the terror incident, Jin had shown not only his ability but also his loyalty and affection towards Dante.
"How is your condition?"
"Not good."
It was true that he had suffered serious internal injuries while fighting Kinjelo, but they were not fatal enough to prevent recovery.
However, Ron's internal injuries showed no signs of improvement.
Rather, they were gradually getting worse over time, to the point where even the strong physique of a 10-star warrior seemed insignificant.
"This is serious."
Dante was not aware of Ron's condition. Only about five of Ron's closest associates and Jin knew this fact.
"It is serious, having to rely on your help to protect my grandson, Ron Hailan."
He spoke as if it was not a big deal. It was not boasting but a confidence that there would be no major problem even with such injuries.
However, if the fact that Ron's injuries were much more severe than known was revealed, it was only natural that Hailan would face difficulties beyond its capacity.

"I don't know if it was the red sword aura that caused the problem, or if there was another factor. If I were to suffer such uncontrollable internal injuries, I would naturally expect the day when I would cross swords with your father... It's surprising that not long ago, he was known as the leader of a third-rate terrorist group."
"They might not have revealed their identity, but they must be a tremendous demon."
"Of course. Despite not being able to show all of their power, they were still that strong. When they become complete, they will surely be a figure in the same league as your father."
Jin didn't consider Ron's assessment of his father as an insult. He felt the same way.
Ron let out a deep sigh.
It wasn't because of his injuries. Thinking about his grandson who would have to fight such an existence in the future made his chest tight.
'The second generation of the great forces were fiercely competing with each other, and I expected Dante to eventually stand at the pinnacle... That was not the time for such rosy dreams.'
In order to face such demons, it wasn't enough to compete among the second generation; they had to join forces and fight together.
The same was true for Jiplei, not just the demons.
"What do you think of Beradin Jiplei?"
-Grandfather. If magic can manipulate human minds and memories as it pleases, would you believe it?
The words his grandson said at the banquet hall.
Since then, Ron had been concerned about mental manipulation.
"From the outside, he seems fine. There's no way to immediately confirm whether his mind has been manipulated or not."
"Hidden demons and mind manipulation. Just thinking about those things makes this an incredibly filthy and difficult era. When I was young, I could bring peace to the world with just a single sword."
"It was simple and romantic."
"That romance was realized not by me, but by your father."
Ron shrugged his shoulders and looked up at the sky through the gaping ceiling. It seemed as if bitterness was seeping from the deep wrinkles around his eyes.
"After the Pia distinction is over and this side is sorted out, I'll help you secure Rune Candle's royal authority more easily."
Ron didn't say he would make the impossible possible. He simply said he would help make what was already going to happen more comfortable.
Ron was already certain that Jin would become the king of the swordsmen of Runecandle. It was impossible to imagine the other knights of Runecandle dealing with this steel-like serpent.
"Thank you for your words, Sir Ron."
"Be on your way."
"Yes."
"Oh, and one more thing."
As Jin turned around, Ron grinned with a somewhat malicious smile.
"Pass this message to the Emperor."
"What message should I pass on?"
"In many ways, it's best to make wise choices."
"I understand."
In the capital of Bemont, one could see the imperial palace from anywhere.
The massive tower that seemed to touch the clouds, the palaces spread out below, the four rivers surrounding it, and the wide, white paved roads stretching between them.
The people of the empire were proud of this magnificent structure and enjoyed calling it the Heavenly Palace instead of the Imperial Palace.
No other palace in the world would compare to the grandeur of the Bemont Imperial Palace.
'An imperial palace, the feeling is completely different from when I saw it from afar before regression. I've heard it's unrivaled in luxury and grandeur, but...'
Jin didn't expect it to be this majestic.
Moreover, countless servants must be managing it, as there was not a single speck of dirt on the wide, white roads that seemed to span hundreds of steps.

The imperial carriage carrying Jin came to a smooth stop, and the guards lined up along the road saluted him. Jin naturally accepted the salute, and the emperor was watching the scene with the officials from the top floor of the tower.
"What do you think? Will Jin Runecandle accept my proposal?"
The officials bowed their heads in response to the Emperor's question.
"Well, if I knew that in advance, I wouldn't have needed to meet like this. I asked a pointless question."
The officials bowed their heads again.
In fact, the officials the Emperor brought to the tower had all lost their voices long ago, so they couldn't answer in the first place.
"Instead, I should be able to confirm Jin Runecandle's basic nature with my own eyes using your abilities."
Clank-!
Suddenly, the Emperor threw open the window and grabbed the neck of the official closest to him.
Without a moment's hesitation, he lifted the official and casually threw him out of the window.
The official couldn't scream, but Jin didn't miss the sight of him falling to the ground.
